heros.infro: Simeon I the Great ruled over Bulgaria from  893 to  927. He successfully fought the Byzantines, Magyars and Serbs. These conflicts led Bulgaria to it's greatest territorial expansion ever. This made the First Bulgarian Empire one of the most powerful of its time in Eastern Europe.
heros.name: Simeon I
